posts.text:
71 years ago, 14-year-old Emmett Till was lynched by white supremacists.
 
His mother, Mamie Till-Mobley, held an open-casket wake so the world could see what hatred had done to her son.
 
We will never let their history be erased or forgotten.
posts.summary: Honors Emmett Till's memory, opposes historical erasure of racial violence
